```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(tidyverse)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Mm.eg.db)
set.seed(1)
all_gsea_results = readRDS("gsea_results_canonical_neurons.rds")
```

Axoneme assembly result - strong and consistent across multiple cell types

15_Histaminergic
```{r}
cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females = all_gsea_results %>% filter(cluster == "15_Histaminergic") %>% filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
    filter(contrast %in% c("prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f","early_amyloid_contrast_f","late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f","aging_contrast_f")) %>% 
  filter(Description == "axoneme assembly")

cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females$sig_label = case_when(
  cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females$p.adjust < 0.001 ~ "***",
  cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females$p.adjust < 0.01 ~ "**",
  cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females$p.adjust < 0.05 ~ "*",
  TRUE ~ ""
)
cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females$Description = str_to_title(cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females$Description)

cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females = cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females %>% mutate(
  contrast = case_when(
    contrast == "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m" ~ "14 Month 5X vs Ntg M",
    contrast == "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f" ~ "14 Month 5X vs Ntg F",
    contrast == "early_amyloid_contrast_m" ~ "6 Month 5X vs Ntg M",
    contrast == "early_amyloid_contrast_f" ~ "6 Month 5X vs Ntg F",
    contrast == "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_m" ~ "14 Month 5X vs 6 Month 5X M",
    contrast == "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f" ~ "14 Month 5X vs 6 Month 5X F",
    contrast == "aging_contrast_m" ~ "14 Month Ntg vs 6 Month Ntg M",
    contrast == "aging_contrast_f" ~ "14 Month Ntg vs 6 Month Ntg F",
    contrast == "effect_of_sex_old_ntg" ~ "14 Month Ntg F vs 14 Month Ntg M",
    contrast == "effect_of_sex_old_5x" ~ "14 Month 5X F vs 14 Month 5X M",
    contrast == "effect_of_sex_young_ntg" ~ "6 Month Ntg F vs 6 Month Ntg M",
    contrast == "effect_of_sex_young_5x" ~ "6 Month 5X F vs 6 Month 5X M",
    .default = contrast
  )
)
```

Plot all together in same patchwork
```{r}
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)

# Shared contrast factor levels (controls x-axis order and alignment)
contrast_levels <- c("14 Month 5X vs 6 Month 5X F", 
                     "14 Month 5X vs Ntg F", 
                     "14 Month Ntg vs 6 Month Ntg F", 
                     "6 Month 5X vs Ntg F")

# Shared NES limit
nes_max <- max(abs(c(
  cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females$NES,
  cilia_orexin_comparisons_females$NES,
  cilia_glp1r_comparisons_females$NES
)))

# Prepare each dataset with shared factor
df_hist <- cilia_histaminergic_comparisons_females %>% 
  filter(contrast %in% contrast_levels) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrast_levels))

df_orex <- cilia_orexin_comparisons_females %>% 
  filter(contrast %in% contrast_levels) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrast_levels))

df_glp1r <- cilia_glp1r_comparisons_females %>% 
  filter(contrast %in% contrast_levels) %>%
  mutate(contrast = factor(contrast, levels = contrast_levels))

# Common pieces
common_fill <- scale_fill_distiller(
  palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
  limits = c(-nes_max, nes_max), name = "NES"
)

common_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 25, hjust = 0.5,margin = margin(t = 0))
  )

# Plot 1
p1 <- ggplot(df_hist, aes(x = contrast, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  common_fill +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Histaminergic Neurons") +
  common_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

# Plot 2
p2 <- ggplot(df_orex, aes(x = contrast, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  common_fill +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Hypocretin/Orexin Neurons") +
  common_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

# Plot 3
p3 <- ggplot(df_glp1r, aes(x = contrast, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  common_fill +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15), drop = FALSE) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "*Glp1r*+/*Lepr*+ Neurons") +
  common_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1, hjust = 1, size = 20,
                                    face = "bold", color = "black"))
# Combine
combined_plot <- p1 / p2 / p3 +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

ggsave("cilia-combined-aligned.pdf", combined_plot, width = 10, height = 9)
```


Show NES of ciliary pathways relative to significant results
```{r}
library(tidyverse)

# --- Curated ciliary hits, per cluster -------------------------------------
cilia_terms_by_cluster <- tribble(
  ~cluster,                ~Description,
  "44_Glp1r_Lepr",         "axoneme assembly",
  "15_Histaminergic",      "axoneme assembly",
  "19_Orexin_Hypocretin",  "axoneme assembly"
) %>% mutate(is_cilia = TRUE)

# --- Scope and labels ------------------------------------------------------
ciliary_clusters_selected <- c("44_Glp1r_Lepr",
                    "15_Histaminergic",
                    "19_Orexin_Hypocretin")

contrast_labels <- c("early_amyloid_contrast_f"         = "6 Month 5X vs Ntg F",
                     "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f"     = "14 Month 5X vs Ntg F",
                     "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f" = "14 Month 5X vs 6 Month 5X F",
                     "aging_contrast_f"                 = "14 Month Ntg vs 6 Month Ntg F")

# --- Plotting frame --------------------------------------------------------
cilia_df <- all_gsea_results %>%
  filter(cluster %in% ciliary_clusters_selected, contrast %in% names(contrast_labels)) %>%
  left_join(cilia_terms_by_cluster, by = c("cluster", "Description")) %>%
  mutate(
    is_cilia       = replace_na(is_cilia, FALSE),
    neglog_fdr     = -log10(p.adjust),
    contrast_label = factor(contrast_labels[contrast], levels = unname(contrast_labels))
  )

cilia_df = cilia_df %>% mutate(cluster = case_when(
  cluster == "19_Orexin_Hypocretin" ~ "Hypocretin/Orexin Neurons",
  cluster == "15_Histaminergic" ~ "Histaminergic Neurons",
  cluster == "44_Glp1r_Lepr" ~ "Glp1r+/Lepr+ Neurons"
))

cilia_bg     <- filter(cilia_df, !is_cilia)
cilia_fg     <- filter(cilia_df,  is_cilia)
cilia_bg_sig <- filter(cilia_df, !is_cilia, p.adjust < 0.05)
cilia_fg_sig <- filter(cilia_df,  is_cilia, p.adjust < 0.05)

theme_cilia <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 14) +
  theme(axis.text          = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black",size = 25),
        axis.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 17),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "grey90"),
        panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
        strip.text         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 25),
        plot.title         = element_text(face = "bold", size = 18, hjust = 0.5),
        plot.subtitle      = element_text(size = 11, hjust = 0.5))


# --- Plot 2: direction of effect, significant terms only -------------------
cilia_nes_plot <- ggplot(cilia_df, aes(NES, cluster)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "grey30", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_jitter(data = cilia_bg_sig, width = 0,
              height = 0.18, size = 1.5, alpha = 0.28, color = "grey65") +
  geom_jitter(data = cilia_fg_sig, width = 0,
              height = 0.18, size = 6, alpha = 0.95,
              shape = 21, fill = "#C0392B", color = "black", stroke = 0.5) +
  facet_wrap(~ contrast_label, ncol = 2,
             labeller = labeller(contrast_label = label_wrap_gen(50))) +
  scale_x_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0.05)) +
    scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 20)) + #wrap text to new line after 20 characters 
  labs(x = "Normalized enrichment score (NES)", y = NULL) +
  theme_cilia

ggsave("cilia-nes-among-significant.pdf", cilia_nes_plot, width = 16, height = 11)
```

Supplementary plot showing all comparisons
```{r}
# Supplementary: Ciliary (A) and Pmch (B) pathway heatmaps — all contrasts
library(ggtext)
library(patchwork)

# ── All 12 contrasts and labels ───────────────────────────────────────────────
all_contrasts <- c(
  "early_amyloid_contrast_f", "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f", "aging_contrast_f",
  "early_amyloid_contrast_m", "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_m", "aging_contrast_m",
  "effect_of_sex_young_ntg", "effect_of_sex_young_5x",
  "effect_of_sex_old_ntg", "effect_of_sex_old_5x"
)

contrast_label_map <- c(
  "early_amyloid_contrast_f"         = "6 Month 5X vs Ntg F",
  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f"     = "14 Month 5X vs Ntg F",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_f" = "14 Month 5X vs 6 Month 5X F",
  "aging_contrast_f"                 = "14 Month Ntg vs 6 Month Ntg F",
  "early_amyloid_contrast_m"         = "6 Month 5X vs Ntg M",
  "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m"     = "14 Month 5X vs Ntg M",
  "late_vs_early_amyloid_contrast_m" = "14 Month 5X vs 6 Month 5X M",
  "aging_contrast_m"                 = "14 Month Ntg vs 6 Month Ntg M",
  "effect_of_sex_young_ntg"          = "6 Month Ntg F vs 6 Month Ntg M",
  "effect_of_sex_young_5x"           = "6 Month 5X F vs 6 Month 5X M",
  "effect_of_sex_old_ntg"            = "14 Month Ntg F vs 14 Month Ntg M",
  "effect_of_sex_old_5x"             = "14 Month 5X F vs 14 Month 5X M"
)

contrast_order <- unname(contrast_label_map)

# ── Helper: pull & format for any cluster × terms ─────────────────────────────
prep_supp_heatmap <- function(cluster_id, terms) {
  all_gsea_results %>%
    filter(cluster == cluster_id,
           contrast %in% all_contrasts,
           Description %in% terms) %>%
    mutate(
      sig_label   = case_when(p.adjust < 0.001 ~ "***",
                              p.adjust < 0.01  ~ "**",
                              p.adjust < 0.05  ~ "*",
                              TRUE ~ ""),
      Description = str_to_title(Description),
      contrast    = contrast_label_map[contrast],
      contrast    = factor(contrast, levels = contrast_order)
    )
}

# ── Derive selected terms ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
orexin_cilia_terms <- c("axoneme assembly")

mch_selected_terms <- all_gsea_results %>%
  filter(cluster == "40_Mch", p.adjust < 0.05,
         contrast %in% c("prolonged_amyloid_contrast_m", "prolonged_amyloid_contrast_f")) %>%
  count(Description) %>%
  filter(n == 2) %>%
  pull(Description)

# ── Prepare data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
df_cilia_hist  <- prep_supp_heatmap("15_Histaminergic",     "axoneme assembly")
df_cilia_orex  <- prep_supp_heatmap("19_Orexin_Hypocretin", orexin_cilia_terms)
df_cilia_glp1r <- prep_supp_heatmap("44_Glp1r_Lepr",       "axoneme assembly")
df_mch         <- prep_supp_heatmap("40_Mch",               mch_selected_terms)

# ── Separate NES scales for panel A vs B ──────────────────────────────────────
cilia_nes_max <- max(abs(c(df_cilia_hist$NES, df_cilia_orex$NES, df_cilia_glp1r$NES)))
mch_nes_max   <- max(abs(df_mch$NES))

fill_cilia <- scale_fill_distiller(
  palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
  limits  = c(-cilia_nes_max, cilia_nes_max), name = "NES"
)

fill_mch <- scale_fill_distiller(
  palette = "RdBu", direction = -1,
  limits  = c(-mch_nes_max, mch_nes_max), name = "NES"
)

# ── Shared theme ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
supp_theme <- theme_minimal(base_family = "Helvetica", base_size = 18) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y  = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
    panel.grid   = element_blank(),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title   = element_markdown(face = "bold", size = 30, hjust = 0.5),
    plot.tag     = element_text(face = "bold", size = 22)
  )

# ── Panel A sub-plots: Ciliary pathways ───────────────────────────────────────
pa1 <- ggplot(df_cilia_hist, aes(x = contrast, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  fill_cilia +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Histaminergic Neurons", tag = "A") +
  supp_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

pa2 <- ggplot(df_cilia_orex, aes(x = contrast, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  fill_cilia +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "Hypocretin/Orexin Neurons") +
  supp_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_blank())

pa3 <- ggplot(df_cilia_glp1r, aes(x = contrast, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  fill_cilia +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "*Glp1r*+/*Lepr*+ Neurons") +
  supp_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1.1, hjust = 1,
                                    face = "bold", color = "black"))

# ── Panel B: Pmch biosynthesis pathways ───────────────────────────────────────
pb1 <- ggplot(df_mch, aes(x = contrast, y = Description, fill = NES)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 10, fontface = "bold", color = "black") +
  fill_mch +
  scale_x_discrete(drop = FALSE, labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 15)) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = function(x) str_wrap(x, width = 30)) +
  labs(x = "", y = "", title = "*Pmch*+ Neurons", tag = "B") +
  supp_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 1.1, hjust = 1,
                                    face = "bold", color = "black"))

# ── Combine: nest A so its 3 subplots share one legend, B gets its own ────────
panel_a <- (pa1 / pa2 / pa3) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(1, 1, 1), guides = "collect") &
  theme(legend.position = "right")

panel_b <- pb1 + theme(legend.position = "right")

supp_fig <- wrap_elements(panel_a) / wrap_elements(panel_b) +
  plot_layout(heights = c(5, 11))

ggsave("supp-cilia-mch-all-contrasts.pdf", supp_fig, width = 18, height = 28)
ggsave("supp-cilia-mch-all-contrasts.png", supp_fig, width = 18, height = 28)
```
